narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as the US-Iran kinetic exchange escalates beyond a one-off strike, with Iran retaliating and shooting down a US Apache. Simultaneous Ukraine deep strikes and Israel's two-front war signal a multi-theater conflict that markets are underpricing, driving flows into safe havens.
narratives.trade_implication: Long gold, short S&P 500 futures; hedge with VIX calls and long-dated US Treasuries.

narratives.title: Hormuz Blockade Structural Oil Shock
narratives.summary: The EIA's extended Hormuz blockade timeline through Q3 2026 and Kuwait's pipeline bypass discussions confirm a structural supply disruption. Oil prices are rallying as the blockade persists, with WTI forecast raised to $88.32, but diplomatic off-ramps create two-way risk.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude futures and energy equities; add Brent call spreads for upside, but hedge with short-dated puts on any Iran deal headlines.

narratives.title: Institutional DeFi and Crypto Divergence
narratives.summary: While BTC crashed on macro risk-off, institutional flows into crypto infrastructure continue, as evidenced by Janus Henderson's partnership with Ethena for tokenized CLOs. This signals a bifurcation between speculative retail crypto and serious institutional adoption, with capital rotating into regulated DeFi plays.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate ENA and other institutional-grade DeFi tokens; short BTC against long ETH or SOL to capture the divergence.
